title: Valorant Sound: Los Angeles
intro: riot games tapped ihc to launch VALORANT INTO 2026 WITH A FRESH CAMPAIGN.

introPieces.html:
To reinvigorate fans of Valorant, Riot Games is kicked the year off right with a creator and fan forward event full of teases.

Based around the latest campaign, Why We Fight Back, this one night only jump off included exclusive content mixed with a fully immersive environment and headlined by a set from Grabbitz. 

To bring this to life for a fully in-world experience, this event was  called Valorant Sound: Los Angeles.
